postInstantiation.premise: Completed instantiation, no retained active frames/continuations, only segment-lifetime differences. Exported functions and every literal function reference are conservative roots. Host obtains internal function references only through ordinary Wasm interfaces. No debugger/engine-private introspection. Time, resource-pressure/OOM effects are excluded; other internal nondeterministic choices are coupled.
